scope: Typed high-level reads/writes, direct channels, message edit/delete shortcuts, priority and silent post delivery, existing file IDs, and one-post multipart upload of one to five documents.

runtime_contract.input_files: Reusable BufferedInputFile and FSInputFile with bounded chunks, explicit/guessed MIME type and one fresh owned handle per filesystem read.
runtime_contract.ownership: FSInputFile closes its handle on completion/cancellation; caller retains ownership of the path and file. BufferedInputFile.from_file is eager.
runtime_contract.post_delivery: MessagePriority maps only to metadata.priority; silent maps only to the query; file_ids remain ordered body data. Root-only priority and invalid flag combinations fail before the network.
runtime_contract.writes: No automatic retry. Malformed or mismatched successful writes become RequestOutcomeUnknown; an upload confirmed before an unconfirmed post reports every potentially unattached file ID.
runtime_contract.generated_boundary: Facade and multipart transport are maintained manually; the E7-01 generated registry is unchanged.

provenance.donor: aiogram.types.input_file at pinned aiogram v3.31.0 commit 97cfe79fa0ac9459d498bdb15cb7cb0530dbaac7
provenance.adaptation: Removed Telegram Bot/session and URLInputFile coupling; replaced aiofiles with stdlib asyncio.to_thread and added Mattermost MIME/filename validation.

native_stand.credential: ordinary bot token; no setup credential or administrative fallback
native_stand.upload: 35 bytes streamed in 7-byte chunks and downloaded with the ordinary bot credential; exact bytes matched
native_stand.cleanup: created posts soft-deleted; direct-channel creation is idempotent

native_stand.e7_04_required_matrix: Mattermost 11.1 baseline and current 12.x priority/silent/one-to-five-file scenarios with an ordinary bot token
